data.revised_prompt: Stylized concept art of a single original floating AI mascot named Mofei, centered full character on a pale blue-white studio background with generous padding. The mascot is an Android-inspired concept revision with a v3 body silhouette: a compact flattened horizontal oval thin crystal-glass pod, visibly wider than tall, approximately 1.36:1 width-to-height, with a broad rounded top and softly tapered lower edge; never spherical and never a long capsule. Material: delicate thin blown glass, clear refraction, gentle inner glow, subtle caustics, Apple-like liquid glass, clear cool-white and icy-blue shell, deep-ocean-blue luminous inner space, not opaque plastic/vinyl/chrome/toy. Front face: a dominant integrated rounded-square deep-blue optical visor occupying 56% of body width and 48% of body height, no mouth, two large widely spaced vertical white-blue luminous eyes within the visor. Around the body, retain a single thin blue-white orbit ribbon sweeping diagonally around the lower shell. Critical side detail: include v4-style large screenshot-recognition framing with four separate transparent glass rounded-corner brackets, upper-left and lower-left on the left side, upper-right and lower-right on the right side; each bracket points inward toward the visor, with cyan scan-light inner edges and enough empty gap to clearly read as an image capture / focus frame. The large corner brackets float close to the body, not headphones, gears, or earcups. No arms, legs, or base. Clean studio composition, no text, labels, logos, watermark, poster panels, humans, or scenery.
